lines.text: Jesus sends two disciples into the city, where a man carrying a jug of water leads them to a large upper room.
At evening Jesus arrives with the Twelve and says one of them, dipping his hand into the bowl, will betray Him.
Jesus breaks bread and calls it His body, then gives the disciples a cup and calls it His blood of the covenant.
Jesus says He will drink the fruit of the vine anew in the temple courts, and after He has risen He will go ahead of them into Galilee.
After a hymn they go to the Garden of Gethsemane, where Jesus says Peter will deny Him three times before the rooster crows twice.
